messages:
deploy-bot: Started rollout 2026-03-20T10:12Z - release v4.1.0 -> route /generate model-routing:v4. Canary cohort: 5%. Feature flag 'gen_v4_enabled' ramping to 5%. Runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/ff-rollout

mira: watching metrics now, will call out anything noisy.

alex: quick heads-up — p95 latency for cohort A +120ms at 10:14, baseline was 240ms -> 360ms.

sam: can you paste the chart or a short snapshot?

mira: snapshot: error rate jumped 0.2% -> 1.6% around 10:14, CPU on canary nodes up ~18%. link: https://metrics/r/shot/abc123

jamie: agree we should pause the ramp and pin to v3 while we triage. soft-freeze the flag.

mira: plan to execute flag weight -> 0 and pin to v3. I'll run the API calls.

sam: @deploy-bot please hold any downstream cohort jobs.

deploy-bot: Hold engaged. Further canary cohorts paused; manual approval required to continue ramp. Action logged.

mira: executing commands now:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.api/flags/gen_v4_enabled/actions
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"
  -d '{"action":"set_weight","variant":"v4","weight":0}'

curl -X POST https://internal.api/flags/gen_v4_enabled/actions
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"
  -d '{"action":"pin_variant","variant":"v3"}'
```

alex: confirmed via audit logs: gen_v4_enabled weight set to 0 at 10:16UTC, variant v3 pinned. Traffic to v4 -> 0%.

jamie: adding release note: "v4.1.0 canary paused due to elevated latency; v3 pinned; investigation ongoing." Pushed to docs and pinged product. Created ticket IR-987 for rollback ops.

sre-oncall: I'll push a hotfix to reduce memory pressure on canary infra and watch for 10min.

sam: if hotfix restores baseline, we can unpin to 1% then 5% with close watch. otherwise keep v3 pinned and schedule a full rollback outside change window.

mira: logs show stack traces referencing attention kernel mismatch in runtime argument selection, bubbling up in quantized path. Tagging eng-runtime.

eng-runtime-bot: triage assigned to @alex and @niko.

alex: picking this up — initial bisect points at kernel-selection path when sequence_len > 2048 and quantized kernel used. Will test patch to fallback to FP kernel for affected nodes.

mira: timeline constraint: change window open until 14:00 UTC. If we don't have a good fix by then, we keep v3 pinned and schedule follow-up.

jamie: acknowledged. I've notified stakeholders in #product and #customer-updates.

sam: summary of actions taken: 
- feature flag 'gen_v4_enabled' weight set v4=0
- variant v3 pinned
- deploy-bot hold confirmed
- rollback ticket IR-987 created
- eng-runtime triage started

mira: will post to #incidents if we escalate to full rollback. For now monitoring at 1min cadence.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics paused at 10:16UTC. All actions recorded in deployment audit.

alex: rolling quick patch to canary infra now (config change to force FP kernel on affected nodes). Will report results in ~7m.

mira: if patch fails, keep the pin and we'll coordinate formal rollback. If patch succeeds, we'll resume with a cautious 1% ramp and signal step-up criteria in the runbook.

sam: thanks all — keep updates short and attach any dashboards or logs.
